items.question: How does the 100-Night Free Trial work?
items.answer: Sleep on your new mattress for up to 100 nights. If you're not completely satisfied at any point during the trial, just contact us and we'll arrange a free pickup and give you a full refund. No questions asked, no restocking fees. We believe that strongly in our product.

items.question: Which mattress is right for back pain?
items.answer: Our Ortho Memory Foam Mattress is specifically designed for back pain relief. The 7-zone support system provides targeted firmness for your lumbar region while keeping your shoulders and hips cushioned. Over 85% of our customers with chronic back pain report significant improvement within 30 days.

items.question: How is a compressed mattress delivered?
items.answer: We use advanced compression technology to roll your mattress into a compact box. Our delivery team brings it to your room, unpacks it, and lets it expand. It reaches full size in 24-48 hours. This doesn't affect the quality or lifespan in any way — it's the same technology used by premium global brands.

items.question: Will the mattress sag over time?
items.answer: Our mattresses use high-density foam (40+ kg/m3) that's engineered to retain its shape for a decade. We back this with a 10-year warranty that covers any sagging greater than 1 inch. In independent testing, our mattresses showed less than 5% deformation after 10 years of simulated use.

items.question: Is EMI available?
items.answer: Yes! We offer No Cost EMI starting at Rs. 334/month on all major credit cards and select debit cards (HDFC, ICICI, SBI, Axis, and more). You can also pay via Bajaj Finserv, ZestMoney, or Simpl for flexible installment options.

items.question: Do you deliver and set up for free?
items.answer: Absolutely. Every order includes free delivery and in-room setup. Our trained team will carry the mattress to your bedroom, unpack it, place it on your bed frame, and take away all the packaging. Available in 19,000+ pin codes across India.
